verdict.rationale: Lambda publishes a documented REST API with an OpenAPI spec for managing cloud resources (docs-31) and a public pricing page (docs-41, docs-28). An unofficial CLI/MCP tool lets agents "find" and launch GPU instances through it (comm-3), which implies some programmatic catalog query. However, no evidence explicitly documents an endpoint that returns instance types with live pricing and availability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a catalog/instance-types endpoint returning live prices and per-region availability, machine-readable pricing data (rather than a marketing page), first-party agent-oriented docs, and independent hands-on corroboration of pre-spend querying.
